seo.title: Get it — OpenMixer
seo.description: Install the OpenMixer plugin hosts from signed packages for Fedora, Debian, Raspberry Pi OS and Zynthian, and try them.

hero.title: Install from our packages.
hero.lede: omx-clap-host and plugin-hostd, the plugin hosts OpenMixer runs on, are signed packages for Fedora and Debian, on x86_64 and ARM64. The console itself is not published yet.

install.title: Add the repository, install the packages.

gettingStarted.title: Getting started
gettingStarted.text: It takes a fresh install from silence to one channel audible in the main mix. Everything else in the manual assumes you have done it once.
gettingStarted.link: Read it before you open the surface.

limitations.title: The known limitations
limitations.text: The matrix does not carry audio yet, a show load is not a reset, delay alignment is not saved, and no control surface has been verified on hardware.
limitations.link: The full list is on the features page.
